---
title: "What does the optimized design look like?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import aerosandbox.numpy as np

res = optimize_glider(verbose=False)
sol = res["sol"]
c_root_opt = sol.value(res["vars"]["c_root"])
taper_opt = sol.value(res["vars"]["taper"])
cg_x_opt = sol.value(res["vars"]["cg_x"])

airplane_opt = make_glider(c_root_opt, taper_opt, cg_x_opt)
```

**Answer.** The optimized planform has a [`{python} f"{c_root_opt:.2f}"`]{.key} m root chord and tapers sharply to its lower bound of [`{python} f"{taper_opt:.1f}"`]{.key}. Span, sections, and tail match the chapter constraints (@fig-planform).

```{python}
#| label: fig-planform
#| fig-cap: "Three-view drawing of the optimized foam glider planform."
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 6))
axs = np.array([
    [fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1, projection='3d'), fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2, projection='3d')],
    [fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3, projection='3d'), fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4, projection='3d')]
])
airplane_opt.draw_three_view(axs=axs, show=False)
```
